use_cases: insulating residential garden sheds and hobby workshops without buying a full commercial roll
lining sectional garage doors to block afternoon radiant sun
DIY campervan and caravan wall/roof insulation projects
not_for: applications requiring breathable Class 4 vapour membranes
retrieval.rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Retroshield Handypack represents a compact, DIY-friendly packaged roll format of Kingspan's popular Retroshield reflective bubble insulation. Designed for small residential projects such as garden sheds, workshops, garage doors, and camper conversions, it provides the same 7mm encapsulated air cell structure and dual aluminium foil facings as commercial rolls. It effectively blocks radiant heat transfer and stops condensation without the material surplus of standard 30m² rolls.
